B: Then I'll hang up and call again.

A: What brings you in?
B: Since yesterday my stomach hurts and I also have a fever.
A: Please write your name and phone number here.
B: Yes, I've finished.
A: Please sit and wait a moment. We'll call you soon.

entries.g: Please hold the elevator.
Could you save my seat for a moment?

entries.g:
A: Could you copy these materials for me?
B: Sure. How many copies do you need?
A: Ten. I need them at tomorrow's meeting.
B: Understood. I'll have them done by two this afternoon.

read.true: B promises to finish the copies by two o'clock in the afternoon.
false: A needs five copies of the materials.

B: Yes, I'll definitely come.

read.true: B has something else to do on the day of the picnic.
false: B has agreed to go on the picnic.

entries.g:
A: Shall we go hiking together this weekend?
B: I hurt my leg, so I can't go to the mountain.
A: Then how about a movie?
B: A movie is fine. But I don't watch scary movies.

false: B refused to hike because B dislikes mountains.
